root.label: Stanford Greek life abolition letter signed by over 600

events.label: Stanford Greek life abolition letter signed by over 600

slots.name: letter signatures
slots.sentence: At Stanford University, an open letter that drew more than 600 signatures accused chapters of perpetuating “white supremacy in addition to furthering a culture of misogyny, ableism, classism, homophobia, heteronormativity, and elitism on campus.”

slots.name: start date
slots.sentence: In 2020 after the killing of George Floyd generated widespread campus calls for social justice, another movement to abolish Greek life sprung up.
